title: The Spirit of the Lord Is upon Me
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Jesus came home to Nazareth, where He grew up. On the Sabbath, He went to the meeting house, like always.
There they handed Him a long rolled-up paper called a scroll. It held the words of Isaiah, a prophet from long ago. Jesus stood up and read.
He read, “The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me. He sent Me to heal the brokenhearted, hearts that hurt with sadness.”
p2: Jesus rolled up the scroll and sat down. Everyone stared. He said, “Today these words came true, right in front of you.” Isaiah was talking about Jesus!
When your heart feels sad, Jesus knows. He came to heal hearts, yours too. Tonight, tell Him what makes you sad, and let His love hold you.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
